plugin.name: 📋 Random Next ToDo
plugin.lastUpdateInfo: Added randomProject to open a random project note from a configured folder.
plugin.author: galkin

plugin.commands.name: randomToDo
plugin.commands.description: Select a random active to-do checkbox on the current page and focus it.

plugin.commands.name: randomProject
plugin.commands.description: Open a random project note from the configured project folder and its subfolders.

plugin.commands.name: projectsList
plugin.commands.description: Insert a hierarchical list of project note links from the configured project folder.

plugin.settings.title: Project Folder
plugin.settings.description: Folder path used by randomProject. Notes in this folder and all subfolders are included.

plugin.settings.title: Log Level
plugin.settings.description:
Set how much logging output will be displayed when executing Random Next ToDo commands in NotePlan Plugin Console Logs (NotePlan -> Help -> Plugin Console)

 - DEBUG: Show All Logs
 - INFO: Only Show Info, Warnings, and Errors
 - WARN: Only Show Errors or Warnings
 - ERROR: Only Show Errors
 - none: Don't show any logs
